name: Saikyou Chijo Kamitsukasa Reiko Zenpen
original_name: 最凶痴女上司麗子　前編
source:
Main character sleeps on the train after drinking too much at his farewell party. The car is empty, but a woman sits beside him and suddenly starts to perform a fellatio. The next day this very woman is introduced as his new boss. And she initiates all kinds of sexual harassment.
